description: Look up an X profile and its archived history: each earlier username, display name, bio, location and profile picture, including accounts X no longer shows. Costs 1 credit (or one of a pack's free daily tool searches); finding nothing or failing costs nothing.

max_wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning what has arrived so far (default 50). The tool keeps running on OSINT.SX after that, so its credit may still be used.

query.description: The username (without @), numeric user ID or profile URL.
